summary: This is a routine Form 8-K by Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., depositor for BANK 2022-BNK44 CMBS trust, disclosing that Greystone Servicing Company sold its special servicing division to C-IV Asset Management LLC. C-IV AM assumes the special servicer role for the High Street loan combination governed by the applicable pooling and servicing agreement. No transaction terms involving the registrant are disclosed; this is a servicing/administration update only, with key employees continuing in substantially the same capacities. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, restructuring, or buyback is present.
